provenance: PROFILE=throughput (all-FP4), adopted 2026-08-19: util 0.93 / mnbt 3072 / max-model-len 250000 / VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1. Numbers are Phase-0 harness n=3 boots (receipts/bench-v2-allfp4-default-2026-08-19.json). See receipts/frontier-2026-08-19.md for the PROFILE=fidelity alternative (5/6 criteria, KLD 0.003412). Refreshed 2026-08-19 with per-prompt MTP acceptance (receipts/bench-throughput-acc-fox-2026-08-19.json, n=3): PP 7694.9+/-21.8, TG-fox 185.0+/-0.6 [acc 0.930+/-0.000], TG-essay 93.3+/-0.1 [acc 0.298+/-0.000], boot 56.0+/-0.0s. Re-measured 2026-08-19 at the card's 600 W default after removing lactd's 400 W power_cap (receipts/power-limit-2026-08-19.md, receipts/bench-throughput-600w-2026-08-19.json, n=3): PP 7694.9+/-21.8 -> 9638.9+/-18.3 (+25.3%), TG-fox 187.4+/-0.6 [acc 0.930], TG-essay 94.3+/-0.0 [acc 0.298]. Every earlier number in this repo was measured under the 400 W cap. CONTEXT 250,000 -> 249,600 on 2026-08-19 (late): boot became deterministically impossible at 250,000 (9.26 GiB KV needed vs 9.25 available, vLLM estimate 249,696) after ~10 MiB of load/profile-time memory moved in the post-gates600 window; GDN spec-row gate un-slicing (LIVE correctness fix) is the prime suspect and is kept. Criterion 5 needs >= 238,400. See receipts/ctx-249600-2026-08-19.md.
note: PP/TG are single-request overhead-inclusive metrics (receipts/peer-review-2026-08-18.md section C). acceptance_essay is high-variance across configs; threshold deliberately loose. Robustness is NOT covered by this gate - run tools/stress-gate.py. This baseline gates the throughput profile only; the fidelity profile has its own baseline JSON.

pp_tok_s.description: Prefill prompt throughput, 2051-tok prompt, max_tokens=1, temperature=0, median of 5 reps after warmup.

tg_essay_tok_s.description: Decode throughput on the essay prompt, max_tokens=500, temperature=0, median of 3 reps.

tg_fox_tok_s.description: Decode throughput on the fox prompt, max_tokens=200, temperature=0, median of 3 reps.

max_model_len.description: Served max_model_len from /v1/models; must not have shrunk below the flagship FP8-KV context.

acceptance_essay.description: MTP acceptance rate on the essay prompt, differenced spec_decode_num_accepted/draft counters before vs after the TG-essay run.

sanity_paris.description: Model answers 'The capital of France is' with text containing 'Paris'.

vision_red_blue.description: Model identifies left=red, right=blue on a 256x128 red/blue PNG fixture.

acceptance_fox.description: MTP acceptance rate on the fox prompt, differenced spec_decode_num_accepted/draft counters before vs after the TG-fox run. Tracked separately from the essay figure because acceptance is strongly prompt-dependent.
